cues.text: The team floats behind her. The hero, eyes closed, grips his collar.
He reaches up into a blazing white light.
A tangled black shape shrinks to a speck.
A small white figure in a black doorway.
A stone figure, arms spread, wrapped in barbed wire.
At a golden door painted with eyes, the team looks up.
Shafts of light fall on the stone figure.
Its stone face is the hero's, head bowed.
